summary_reason: Severe tax domain error in the dialogue: '決算申告' (corporate tax return) was paired with '雑損控除' (an individual income tax deduction non-existent in corporate taxation). Additionally, collocation index 2 requires replacement because casualty loss deduction does not have an statutory '上限額' (ceiling).

collocations.text: 雑損控除の上限額を計算する
collocations.reason: Factually inaccurate under Japanese Income Tax Law. Casualty loss deduction (雑損控除) has an income-based floor/deductible threshold (足切り額), but no statutory upper cap (上限額). Practitioners calculate '控除額', not '上限額'.
collocations.suggested_text: 雑損控除の控除額を計算する

dialogue.reason: Domain factual error: '決算申告' is terminology strictly reserved for corporate tax returns (法人税申告). Under Japanese tax law, '雑損控除' is an income deduction exclusive to individuals (所得税法第72条). Corporations deduct disaster losses as expenses/losses (損金/災害損失), not as '雑損控除'. In an accounting firm setting, this must refer to '確定申告' or a client's individual return.
